sources.title: LFM3-1.7B-Heretic-Abliterated-i1-GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM3-1.7B is a text model for local agents and specialized applications from Liquid AI, built on their new tri-hybrid architecture. It targets everyday assistant use, tool calling, structured outputs, long-context work, and edge deployment, with a 256K-token context window.

sources.title: LFM3-1.7B-Heretic-Abliterated — Abliterated Model Card
sources.snippet: LFM3-1.7B-Heretic-Abliterated is a Heretic-ablated variant of LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B, published on Hugging Face by Vortecks. It is 1.7B parameters, runs on a laptop CPU class and other licence. It is distributed across 4 repositories in GGUF, Transformers and GGUF (imatrix) formats, totalling 9.5K downloads.
